solution_steps: Summon Marauding Captain and use his effect to special summon Mataza the Zapper.
By discarding Vorse Raider, activate Curse of Aging.
Equip Mataza with Lightning Blade, then use him to attack both opponents Dragon Zombies.
Finally, finish the puzzle with Marauding's direct attack.
Ring of destruction is not used.
